stockPriority.rule: A matching three-card sleight takes priority over a two-card sleight. A two-card sleight can activate when the stock does not match a three-card sleight.
stockPriority.verification: Explicit general rule in the source introduction; does not establish every slot permutation or conflicts between multiple matching recipes.

twoCardControlsEvidence.basis: Original Steam questioner confirms keyboard combination after advice to press both card-cycling controls. This is input behavior, not arbitrary third-card matching.

rosterEvidence.rikuOrder: No new native-order certification; the book separately groups normal and Dark duel moves.

matchingEvidence.attackOrder: Pure Attack recipes use identity constraints and total; ingredient order is immaterial. Mixed-card recipes retain their specified order, subject to explicit alternatives.
matchingEvidence.twoCardRule: The printed remake guide allows an additional card with two-card sleights; specific prepend/append examples are recorded without inventing a full permutation algorithm.
matchingEvidence.remaining: Middle-slot insertion, competing two-card subsequences, and a general algorithm for every stock remain uncertified. No solver or arbitrary priority rank is introduced.
